title: Image to reusable 3D asset
description: Reconstruct an object from a reference image as editable Three.js code, review it, then reuse the approved model in templates.
status: Integration guide • not installed or tested by this directory
requirements: Coding agent with image and browser access
Bundle TypeScript for the browser; wire deterministic animation before importing
instructions: Read https://github.com/img2threejs/img2threejs and its current setup instructions. Check the installed version and prerequisites before installing anything. Ask me for a reference image and intended result. Create and review a reusable model in a separate working folder. Keep model source, reference provenance, dependencies and review notes together. After I approve the model, adapt a copy to Brand Foundry using docs/TEMPLATE-GUIDE.md. Preserve existing templates. Save a recipe with the source version and output paths. Do not claim integration or installation until verified.

title: 3D camera captions
description: Depth-based captions around a speaker, using timed words, a subject matte, and camera movement.
requirements: Locked-camera landscape talking-head footage; upstream guide targets 5–20 seconds
Word-level timing, fonts and person matte
Upstream guide specifies HyperFrames 0.8.62, FFmpeg and Python dependencies; verify compatibility first
instructions: Inspect the camera-3d-captions skill at https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes-community-skills/tree/master/skills/camera-3d-captions. Check its pinned runtime and dependencies against my installation. Ask for footage, word timing and font choices. Prepare and review a short test separately before adapting anything into Brand Foundry. Save reusable styling separately from footage-specific timing and masks. Preserve provenance and record the tested version in a recipe. Do not upgrade the whole studio silently.

title: AI image and video generation
description: Use a chosen provider and exact model, review the result, and save the successful prompt and settings as a recipe.
status: Planning workflow • no generation API connected
requirements: Choose a provider and exact model ID; informal model names are not verified
Provider account and locally configured credentials
Review cost and output before running a paid request
instructions: Help me choose an available image or video model through my preferred provider. Verify the exact model ID, input schema and current price in official documentation. Ask for references, aspect ratio, duration if video, and budget. Show the proposed request and estimated cost before a paid generation. Keep credentials in local environment configuration, never in a recipe. Save the reviewed output locally, and save prompt, negative prompt, provider, model/version, settings, seed if supported, reference paths and result paths as a recipe. Use approved artwork in an Brand Foundry template.

title: Claude Code / Codex
description: A local coding agent can read this directory, use the recipes, and work with the studio files and HTTP API.
requirements: Agent access to this checkout and local server
instructions: Read AGENTS.md and docs/STUDIO-DIRECTORY.md in this checkout. Fetch /api/directory from the running studio for workflows, recipes and template IDs. Inspect current capabilities rather than assuming tools are connected.

title: Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve
description: Use separately configured editor integrations to place reviewed studio exports on a timeline.
requirements: A separately installed and configured editor integration
instructions: Read docs/AGENT-WORKFLOW.md. Inspect the connected editor tools and their supported import and timeline operations. Render the requested asset, verify the file, then place it only through the available integration. Report placement only after the editor confirms it.

title: Generation providers
description: A place for your future image/video provider connection. This version stores recipes but does not make generation calls or collect API keys.
status: Not connected • no paid calls available
requirements: Provider selection and API integration are a future phase
instructions: Follow the AI image and video generation workflow. Verify provider and exact model independently. Never put an API key in the catalog, recipe JSON or public repository.
